Two sayings in one report: the dinar report (chain above) and «الخير معقود بنواصي الخيل» with Shabib's own «سمعته يقول سمعت النبي» (a second saying with its own isnad): ruling needed; only the first is read as a route.
«الحى» (people who narrate) is an unnamed group, kept at its place in the chain.
Sufyan's remark about Hasan b. Imara and Shabib's retraction are in the scene of the same report: left out.
«سمعت الحى، يحدثون عن عروة» : «الحى» is an unnamed group of people, and the chain runs through them to Urwa
Sufyan's «كان الحسن بن عمارة جاءنا بهذا الحديث عنه» names another transmitter of the same saying: a variant group
Urwa's «سمعت النبي ... الخير معقود بنواصي الخيل» is a second saying with its own isnad (Shabib, then Urwa): needs a ruling, not written as a route
